newsitem.title: USA: Nabors to buy two Samson units for $85 million.
newsitem.headline: Nabors to buy two Samson units for $85 million.

text.p: Nabors Industries Inc. said Monday it agreed to acquire Samson Rig Co. and Rig Properties Inc. from a subsidiary of Samson Investment Co. for $85 million in cash.

The acquisition includes 25 rigs, most of which can drill deeper than 15,000 feet, and component equipment. The two companies also own a large amount of real estate and buildings and yard facilities, Nabors said.
Samson Investment plans to redeploy the proceeds of the sale in its oil and gas acquisition and exploration activities, Nabors added.
It said the deal is expected to close in May.
Privately owned Samson Investment has exploration and production offices located in Tulsa, Calgary, Alberta, Venezuela and Russia.

Nabors, based in Houston, markets over 360 land drilling and 78 land well servicing rigs. It operates 25 offshore platform rigs, two of which are under construction. It also provides oilfield engineering, civil construction, logistics and management services.
Nabors' stock was unchanged at $18.50 on the American Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
